description: Delete an automation for good and cancel every active enrolment in it, so nobody is sent another step. Answers enrollments_canceled. It cannot be undone: to stop it for a while and continue everyone later, use set_automation_status with paused instead. Mail already sent and its history stay.

automation_id.description: The automation's id from list_automations (a UUID), not its name or slug

name: delete_automation
